sample_voxels: sample a 3D feature volume at arbitrary point locations using bilinear or trilinear interpolation
pc_to_vox: convert a point cloud tensor into voxel grid coordinates with optional bounding box filtering
normalize_keypoints: normalize 3D keypoints from voxel space to the -1 to 1 coordinate range for grid sampling
diff_grid_sample: perform differentiable 3D trilinear interpolation on a feature volume at normalized sample point locations
in_grid: check which 3D voxel coordinates fall within the valid bounds of a given grid volume
